description: Capabilities granted to the main window. Deliberately minimal: the renderer uses no Tauri JS API (#316) and this window loads only PlotRoom's own served origin, so it needs no IPC surface beyond what the updater plugin registers for itself. `wdio-webdriver:default` is #317's native shell suite's embedded WebDriver server -- the plugin is only ever registered in a debug build (see `lib.rs`), never invoked from this renderer's own JS either way.
